headline: Storm alert: 60 kmph winds expected in several districts by 9 AM
summary: The weather office has also warned of heavy rainfall across four divisions of Bangladesh.
details: The weather office has issued a warning for several districts, predicting storms with wind speeds of up to 60 kmph by 9 AM.
In addition to the wind alerts, the meteorological department has warned of heavy rainfall across four divisions of the country.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to remain cautious as the weather conditions deteriorate.
These sudden weather shifts are expected to impact daily commutes and outdoor activities across the identified regions.
caption:

headline_marked: Nahid Islam says [[new Indian envoy should apologize]] for past support of AL
headline: Nahid Islam says new Indian envoy should apologize for past support of AL
summary: The opposition Chief Whip argued in Parliament that India must acknowledge its role in keeping the previous government in power and providing shelter to accused perpetrators of the July uprising.
details: Opposition Chief Whip and NCP convener Nahid Islam stated in Parliament that the newly appointed Indian High Commissioner should have apologized for India's support of the Awami League government over the last 16 years.
caption:
Nahid Islam demands an apology from India's new envoy over the previous regime's support and shelter for uprising accused.

Opposition Chief Whip and NCP convener Nahid Islam stated in Parliament that the newly appointed Indian High Commissioner should have apologized for India's support of the Awami League government over the last 16 years.

#Bangladesh #India #Diplomacy #NahidIslam #Politics

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
